verses.text: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
lines: How long will you hide your face from me?

verses.text: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
lines: How long shall I take counsel in my soul,
having sorrow in my heart every day?
How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

verses.text: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
lines: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God.
Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

verses.text: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
lines: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;”
lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

verses.text: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.
lines: But I trust in your loving kindness.
My heart rejoices in your salvation.

verses.text: I will sing to Yahweh, because he has been good to me.
lines: because he has been good to me.
